- **New Computerised Transit System (NCTS):** A European-standard electronic customs system used to monitor and streamline the international movement of goods across Common Transit countries, with Phase 5 deployments rolling out through late 2024.[[1]](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/online-services/online-services-and-databases-customs/new-computerised-transit-system-ncts_en)[[2]](https://ncts.ge/)
- **National Car Testing Service (NCT):** The official compulsory vehicle inspection program in Ireland, managed via the [National Car Testing Service](https://www.ncts.ie/).[[1]](https://www.ncts.ie/)
- **Naval Computer and Telecommunications Station (NCTS):** U.S. Navy communication commands—such as [NCTS San Diego](https://www.navifor.usff.navy.mil/ncts-sandiego/) or NCTS Sicily—that provide secure tactical and internet communications for fleet operations.[[1]](https://www.navifor.usff.navy.mil/ncts-sandiego/)[[2]](https://www.navy.mil/Press-Office/News-Stories/Article/2250525/ncts-sicily-who-we-are-what-we-do/)
- **National Ceramic Tile & Stone, Corp. (NCTS Corp):** A large commercial tile and stone contractor operating on the West Coast of the United States.[[1]](https://www.nctscorp.com/)
- **Nationally Certified Transition Specialist (NCTS):** A professional credential offered by the [Council for Exceptional Children](https://exceptionalchildren.org/nationally-certified-transition-specialist-ncts) for secondary special education transition specialists.[[1]](https://exceptionalchildren.org/nationally-certified-transition-specialist-ncts)
- **NCTS (Music Artist):** A Brazilian phonk and electronic music artist known for viral tracks like *NEXT!* and *stop!* on streaming platforms like [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6BWtcMF39LT5Db5FT54YYG).[[1]](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6BWtcMF39LT5Db5FT54YYG)[[2]](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=EJfB_zMmqes)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dT9uBhbTo1k)
